items.note: While mathematics defines the 21-million limit, consensus is what actually defends it. Backed by strong game-theoretic incentives, Bitcoin solves the tragedy of the commons for money creation: since money issuance in Bitcoin is transparent and strictly enforced by the network, altering it demands near-total consensus. However, money creation directly hurts anyone whose personal holdings don't increase at the same percentage rate as the total money supply. As a result, the network is always incentivized to consent against additional money creation.
